::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Plantations no longer count as natural (v3.1, approximation).** Plantations
(IUCN 14.3) and artificial aquatic classes are now treated as anthropogenic.
Until the full pipeline can be rerun, natural ecosystem loss and BF-NEE are
derived from the v3 results by removing these classes; the exact values lie
between the values shown and the v3 values ([Method](method.qmd#plantations)).
The interactive map still shows the v3 values.
:::
